div.head: Northu 29
div.ab: Gif preost oðerne forseo oððe gebismrige mid worde oððe mid weorce, gebete þæt.
Gif preost oðerne forseo oððe gebismrige mid worde oððe mid weorce, gebete þæt.
Wenn éin Priester den andern verachtet oder beschimpft durch Wort oder durch That, büsse er das.
If a priest despises or insults another by word or by deed, let him atone for it.
If a priest scorns or insults another by word or deed, he is to compensate for it.
If a priest disrespects or shames another with words or deeds, he is to atone for that.
div.note: Some of Liebermann’s notes here are cut off in the gutter of the scan used, and are still to be completed.
Editors unnecessarily alter ‘gebismrige’ to ‘-smirige’. Liebermann compares the Canons of Edgar.
